label.en: Use HTTP polling instead of WebSocket

hint.en: By default the device keeps a persistent WebSocket connection open to Moonraker. Enable this to disable the WebSocket and instead pull data over HTTP at a fixed interval.
How often to pull data from Moonraker over HTTP. Only used when HTTP polling is enabled above.
